grades: Juniors and seniors (freshmen and sophomores case by case)
name: Dual Enrollment and Dual Credit (Piedmont Virginia Community College)
what_you_do: Earn college and high school credit at the same time. Take PVCC classes at your high school, on campus or online. Early College students can earn a two year degree or certificate with their diploma.
who_can_apply: Juniors and seniors at a school that takes part. You must meet the rules to join, and your school and a parent or guardian must say yes. Homeschooled juniors and seniors can take Dual Credit classes. Freshmen and sophomores are looked at one by one.
pay_detail: Dual enrollment classes taught in your high school are no cost to the student. Dual Credit classes taken on your own outside the school day require tuition.
deadline_text: No deadline on this page. Ask your high school counselor.
how_to_apply: For dual enrollment, sign up with your high school counselor. For Dual Credit, apply through PVCC admissions at admissions@pvcc.edu.
notes: More than 1,200 high school students join each term. Early College has rules to qualify. It may have district scholarships.
